definitions.explanation: A card game in which players draw cards from each other and discard pairs; whoever is left holding the joker (ばば) at the end loses.

examples.japanese: ばば{抜|ぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
ばば{抜|ぬ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{残|のこ}って→残る：01187_nokoru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up being the last one left in Old Maid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦トランプ→トランプ：03864_toranpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧、ばば{抜|ぬ}きや{七並|しちなら}べ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: At New Year the whole family got out the cards and played Old Maid and Sevens.

notes:
ばば here means the joker, the card nobody wants to keep. The game is one of the most common family card games in Japan, along with {七並|しちなら}べ (Sevens) and {神経衰弱|しんけいすいじゃく} (Concentration).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ばば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw the joker; figuratively, to end up with the bad deal
- ばば{抜|ぬ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧: to lose at Old Maid

WATCH OUT:
⟦トランプ→トランプ：03864_toranpu⟧ in Japanese means a deck of playing cards, so ⟦トランプ→トランプ：03864_toranpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to play cards.
